GLKBaseEffect.doc: A simple lighting and shading system for use in shader-based OpenGL rendering.

GLKEffectProperty.doc: The abstract superclass for configuration information used in GLKit rendering effects.

GLKEffectPropertyFog.doc: Fog drawing information for use in GLKit rendering effects.

GLKEffectPropertyLight.doc: Lighting information for use in GLKit rendering effects.

GLKEffectPropertyMaterial.doc: Surface appearance properties for use in GLKit rendering effects.

GLKEffectPropertyTexture.doc: Texture drawing parameters for use in GLKit rendering effects.

GLKEffectPropertyTransform.doc: Coordinate transform information for use in GLKit rendering effects.

GLKReflectionMapEffect.doc: A lighting and shading system that supports reflection mapping for use in shader-based OpenGL rendering.

GLKSkyboxEffect.doc: A simple skybox visual effect for use in shader-based OpenGL rendering.

GLKTextureInfo.doc: Information about OpenGL textures created by the GLKTextureLoader class.

GLKTextureLoader.doc: A utility class that simplifies loading OpenGL or OpenGL ES texture datas from a variety of image file formats.

GLKNamedEffect.doc: A standard interface for objects that provide shader-based OpenGL rendering effects.

GLKFogMode.doc: A mode that describes how the fog component is calculated for the fragment.

GLKFogModeExp.doc: The fog component is calculated as exp(-density * distance) and clamped to the range [0.0, 1.0].

GLKFogModeExp2.doc: The fog component is calculated as exp(-(density * distance)^2) and clamped to the range [0.0, 1.0].

GLKFogModeLinear.doc: The fog component is calculated as (end - distance) / (end - start) and clamped to the range [0.0, 1.0].

GLKLightingType.doc: A constant that describes how lighting is calculated by an effect.

GLKLightingTypePerPixel.doc: Indicates that the inputs to the lighting calculation are interpolated across a triangle and the lighting calculations are performed at each fragment.

GLKLightingTypePerVertex.doc: Indicates that the lighting calculations are performed at each vertex in a triangle and then interpolated across the triangle.

GLKTextureEnvMode.doc: The mode used to combine the texture with other color components.

GLKTextureEnvModeDecal.doc: The output color is calculated by using the texture’s alpha component to blend the texture’s color with the input color.

GLKTextureEnvModeModulate.doc: The output color is calculated by multiplying the texture’s color by the input color.

GLKTextureEnvModeReplace.doc: The output color is set to the color fetched from the texture. The input color is ignored.

GLKTextureInfoAlphaState.doc: Values that describe the alpha information stored in a source image’s pixel data.

GLKTextureInfoAlphaStateNonPremultiplied.doc: Indicates that the color values in the texture were not premultiplied by the alpha value.

GLKTextureInfoAlphaStateNone.doc: Indicates that the texture has no alpha information.

GLKTextureInfoAlphaStatePremultiplied.doc: Indicates that the color values in the texture have already been premultiplied by the alpha value.

GLKTextureInfoOrigin.doc: The location of the origin in the original source image.

GLKTextureInfoOriginBottomLeft.doc: The origin of the texture is in the bottom-left corner.

GLKTextureInfoOriginTopLeft.doc: The origin of the texture is in the top-left corner.

GLKTextureInfoOriginUnknown.doc: The origin of the texture is not supported.

GLKTextureTarget.doc: The kind of texture pointed to by the property.

GLKTextureTargetCt.doc: The number of items in the enumeration.

GLKTextureTargetCubeMap.doc: The texture is a set of six textures that make up a cube map.

GLKVertexAttrib.doc: Values used as indices in OpenGL code to associate vertex data with an attribute in a named shader effect.

GLKVertexAttribColor.doc: This index is used to provide the vertex color to a shader.

GLKVertexAttribNormal.doc: This index is used to provide the vertex normal to a shader.

GLKVertexAttribPosition.doc: This index is used to provide the vertex position to a shader.

GLKVertexAttribTexCoord0.doc: This index is used to provide a set of texture coordinates to a shader.

GLKVertexAttribTexCoord1.doc: This index is used to provide the second set of texture coordinates to a shader.

+cubeMapWithContentsOfFile:options:error.doc: Loads a cube map texture image from a single file and creates a new texture from the data.

+cubeMapWithContentsOfFiles:options:erro.doc: Loads a cube map texture image from a series of files and creates a new texture from the data.

+cubeMapWithContentsOfURL:options:error:.doc: Loads a cube map texture image from a single URL and creates a new texture from the data.

+textureWithCGImage:options:error:.doc: Loads a 2D texture image from a Quartz image and creates a new texture from the data.

+textureWithContentsOfData:options:error.doc: Loads a 2D texture image from a memory range and creates a new texture from the data.

+textureWithContentsOfFile:options:error.doc: Loads a 2D texture image from a file and creates a new texture from the data.

+textureWithContentsOfURL:options:error:.doc: Loads a 2D texture image from a URL and creates a new texture from the data.

-cubeMapWithContentsOfFile:options:queue.doc: Asynchronously loads a cube map texture image from a single file and creates a new texture from the data.

-cubeMapWithContentsOfFiles:options:queu.doc: Asynchronously loads a cube map texture image from a series of files and creates a new texture from the data.

-cubeMapWithContentsOfURL:options:queue:.doc: Asynchronously loads a cube map texture image from a single URL and creates a new texture from the data.

-initWithShareContext:.doc: Initializes a new texture loader object.

-initWithSharegroup:.doc: Initializes a new texture loader object.

-textureWithCGImage:options:queue:comple.doc: Asynchronously loads a 2D texture image from a Quartz image and creates a new texture from the data.

-textureWithContentsOfData:options:queue.doc: Asynchronously loads a 2D texture image from a memory range and creates a new texture from the data.

-textureWithContentsOfFile:options:queue.doc: Asynchronously loads a 2D texture image from a file and creates a new texture from the data.

-textureWithContentsOfURL:options:queue:.doc: Asynchronously loads a 2D texture image from a URL and creates a new texture from the data.

colorMaterialEnabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether or not to use the color vertex attribute when calculating the light’s interaction with the material.

constantColor.doc: A constant color, used when per-vertex color data is not provided.

fog.doc: The fog properties to apply to the scene.

label.doc: A string used to name your effect.

light0.doc: The lighting properties for the first light in the scene.

light1.doc: The lighting properties for the second light in the scene.

light2.doc: The lighting properties for the third light in the scene.

lightModelAmbientColor.doc: The ambient color applied to all primitives rendered by the effect.

lightModelTwoSided.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether lighting is calculated for both sides of a primitive.

lightingType.doc: The strategy the effect uses to calculate light values at each fragment. See GLKLightingType.

material.doc: The material properties used when calculating the light values for a rendered primitive.

texture2d0.doc: The properties for the first texture.

texture2d1.doc: The properties for the second texture.

textureOrder.doc: The order in which textures are applied to rendered primitives.

transform.doc: The modelview, projection and texture transformations applied to the vertex data when the effect is bound.

useConstantColor.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether or not to use the constant color.

color.doc: The color of the fog at maximum density.

density.doc: The rate at which the fog exponent increases.

enabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether fog is applied to the fragment color.

end.doc: The distance in eye coordinates where fog completely covers the color fragment.

mode.doc: The algorithm used to compute the density of the fog applied to the fragment color.

start.doc: The minimum distance in eye coordinates before fog is applied to the fragment color.

ambientColor.doc: The ambient portion of the light.

constantAttenuation.doc: A constant factor applied to the attenuation of a point light or spotlight.

diffuseColor.doc: The diffuse portion of the light.

enabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether calculations should be performed on this light.

linearAttenuation.doc: A linear factor applied to the attenuation of a point light or spotlight.

position.doc: The position of the light in world coordinates.

quadraticAttenuation.doc: A quadratic factor applied to the attenuation of a point light or spotlight.

specularColor.doc: The specular portion of the light.

spotCutoff.doc: The angle in degrees where the spotlight is cut off.

spotDirection.doc: A vector indicating the direction the spotlight is projecting.

spotExponent.doc: A value indicating how focused the spotlight is.

transform.doc: A transform applied to the light’s position and direction before calculating the contribution of the light.

ambientColor.doc: The ambient color of the material.

diffuseColor.doc: The diffuse color of the material.

emissiveColor.doc: The emissive color of the material.

shininess.doc: The shininess of the material, used when calculating specular lighting effects.

specularColor.doc: The specular color of the material.

enabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether this texture is used to texture drawn primitives.

envMode.doc: The mode the texture uses to compute its output fragment color. See GLKTextureEnvMode.

name.doc: The OpenGL name for the texture being sampled by this texture stage.

target.doc: The kind of texture pointed to by the texture stage. See GLKTextureTarget.

modelviewMatrix.doc: The matrix used to transform position coordinates from world space to eye space.

normalMatrix.doc: The matrix used to transform normal coordinates from world space to eye space.

projectionMatrix.doc: The matrix used to transform position coordinates from eye space to projection space.

matrix.doc: The reflection matrix to apply to the normals of the submitted vertices.

textureCubeMap.doc: The texture map to apply in the reflection stage.

label.doc: A string used to name your effect.

textureCubeMap.doc: The texture to apply to the skybox.

transform.doc: The transform applied before drawing the skybox.

alphaState.doc: The state of the alpha component in the loaded texture.

containsMipmaps.doc: A Boolean value that states whether the loaded texture contains mip maps.

height.doc: The height of the loaded texture.

name.doc: The OpenGL context’s name for the texture.

target.doc: The OpenGL binding target for the texture.

textureOrigin.doc: The location of the origin in the loaded texture.

width.doc: The width of the loaded texture.
